messages.msgid: A set of big pointy legs, like the ones found under a tripod.
translations: 一组大而尖的腿，就像在三足机器人用的那种。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Northrop, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the chicken walker.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有诺斯洛普标志的双足机器人组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Northrop, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the tank drone.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有诺斯洛普标志的坦克无人机组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Honda, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the tripod.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有本田标志的三足机器人组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive Beagle Mini-Tank UGV.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tank drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
translations: 一台未激活的"猎兔犬"型无人坦克车。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 5.56mm 弹药和 40mm 榴弹（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，无人车会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并采用内置步枪和榴弹发射器攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: The tank drone rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
translations: 坦克无人机展开并开始寻找目标。

messages.msgid: The tank drone swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!
translations: 坦克无人机旋转炮塔，直接瞄准了你。穿上裤子快跑！

messages.msgid: The chicken bot rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
translations: 双足机器人展开并开始寻找目标。

messages.msgid: The chicken bot swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!
translations: 双足机器人旋转炮塔，直接瞄准了你。穿上裤子快跑！

messages.msgid: This is an inactive Honda Regnal.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, wondering how it fuels its flamethrower and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tribot will then identify you as an ally, roam around or follow you, and impale hostiles with its spiked cable weapons.
translations: 一台未激活的三足机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。它的火焰喷射器的燃料来源成谜。若成功编程放置，三足机器人会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并用其带刺的电缆武器刺穿敌人。

messages.msgid: The tribot rises to its feet and scans the area for contaminants.
translations: 三足机器人开始移动并扫描该地区的污染物。

messages.msgid: The tribot glowers down at you and ignites its flamethrower.  Turns out you hate the smell of napalm.
translations: 三足机器人锁定了你，点燃的喷火器直接瞄准了你。看来你并不喜欢凝固汽油的味道。

messages.msgid: A broken tribot.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的三足机器人。现在它的腿断了一地，世界又多了一份和平。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken tank drone.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的坦克无人机。可能因为巨大的体积和质量的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken chicken walker.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的双足机器人。可能因为巨大的体积和质量的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.  It requires sunlight in order to fire.
translations: 一台未激活的激光塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，激光防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置转轮激光炮攻击附近的所有敌人。它需要日光照射以获取开火所需的能源。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the tripod.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是三足机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: A set of reverse-jointed legs, like the ones found under a chicken walker.
translations: 一组反关节的腿，就像在双足机器人用的那种。

messages.msgid: You got a bad feeling about this flaming eye's intentions.
translations: 你对这只燃烧之眼的意图有种不祥的感觉。
削弱前燃烧之眼的毁灭射线。
燃烧之眼毁灭射线造成的伤害。

messages.msgid: Flaming Eye warms up before activating its destruction ray.
translations: 燃烧之眼毁灭射线发射前提醒信息。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive chicken walker.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the chicken walker will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
translations: 一台未激活的双足机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 5.56mm 弹药和 40mm 榴弹（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，机器人会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并采用内置步枪和榴弹发射器攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: The chicken walker rises to its feet, sways away from you and begins surveying the area.
translations: 双足机器人站起来，摇晃着经过你的身边，开始调查该区域。

messages.msgid: The chicken walker whirrs and aims directly at you.  Take cover!
translations: 双足机器人发出蜂鸣，直接瞄准了你。快找掩护！

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the chicken walker.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是双足机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Beagle tank.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"猎兔犬"型无人坦克的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: A hand-forged collapsible tool with two axe heads and a sharp shovel-like tip on one end.  It can be used as a shovel, or you could chop some zombies with it instead.
translations: 一把手工锻造的可折叠工具，有两个斧刃，一头有一个锋利的铲子状尖端。它可以作为铲子使用，或者你也可以用它来给丧尸做脑白质切除手术。

messages.msgid: A folded glossy handout that appears to be an introduction to living in a massive underground complex.
translations: 一份蜷曲的有光泽的印刷品，似乎是一处大型地下城市的房产广告。

messages.msgid: A notepad with a number of frequencies scribbled on it.
translations: 一个写满了不同电台频率的记事本。

messages.msgid: Aims to make the world more inhospitable and challenging in as many ways as possible, items needed for survival and vehicles are much harder to obtain, destruction and banditry is prevelent, even the weather has taken a turn for the worse, see in game help menu by pressing 0 once in-game for full feature list and option explanations.
translations: 本模组旨在通过各种方式让这个世界变得更加荒凉和富有挑战性。生存必需品和载具的获取难度大幅提升，破坏与劫掠行为四处横行，就连天气也变得愈发恶劣。进入游戏后按“0”键可查看游戏内帮助菜单，以获取完整的特色列表和选项说明。

messages.context: Label for the weariness bar graph
